raw.query: WITH pairs AS ( SELECT b.image_px, b.ms_per_img AS burst64, f.ms_per_img AS floor1, f.ms_per_img / b.ms_per_img - 1.0 AS excess FROM collector_encoder_fn b JOIN collector_encoder_fn f ON b.image_px = f.image_px WHERE b.is_valid AND f.is_valid AND b.engine='compiled' AND b.n_images=64 AND b.source_path LIKE '%fn_multires%' AND f.engine='eager' AND f.n_images=1 AND f.source_path LIKE '%fn_multires%' ) SELECT image_px, ROUND((f.ms_per_img/b.ms_per_img)::numeric,4) AS ratio, ROUND((excess*image_px*image_px)::numeric,0) AS const_a FROM pairs ORDER BY image_px
raw.observed: floor/burst ratio at 224/448/672 px = 4.04 / 1.80 / 1.32; ratio−1 scales as ≈153000/px² → asymptotic to 1.0, never <1.0; at claimed 690 px predicted ratio still 1.32
